# Pack: base

Base commercial knowledge, version 0.2.0.

Domain-neutral commercial-arrangement knowledge: billing bases, pricing models, levers, dimensions, metrics, cost categories, compatibility and reasoning rules, and cross-sector evidence.

Evidence classes: A_DIRECT (directly documented), B_CORROBORATED, C_INFERENCE, D_PROPOSED. C and D are inference or proposal, not observed fact.

## Structures for automation-reduced effort

Scheme `automation_structures`.

<a id="auto-01"></a>

**AUTO-01** Time plus technology fee (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A defensible structure for pricing a service whose human effort has been sharply reduced by automation.

- Related: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials
- Claims: [CLM-B-0032](#clm-b-0032), [CLM-B-0031](#clm-b-0031)
- Attributes: provider_perspective: Easy transition from legacy billing; technology cost recoverable.; client_perspective: Transparent inputs.; principal_risk: Client may expect full labor savings; provider monetizes less productivity upside.; benefit_allocation_note: Benefit largely passes to the client through reduced hours.

<a id="auto-02"></a>

**AUTO-02** Fixed fee for defined output (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A defensible structure for pricing a service whose human effort has been sharply reduced by automation.

- Related: [PM-006](#pm-006) Fixed-fee project, [PM-007](#pm-007) Fixed-fee managed service
- Claims: [CLM-B-0032](#clm-b-0032), [CLM-B-0031](#clm-b-0031)
- Attributes: provider_perspective: Provider captures productivity improvements.; client_perspective: Budget certainty and incentive for efficiency.; principal_risk: Provider bears error, volume and scope risk.; benefit_allocation_note: Benefit is provider-retained until competition or contract terms pass savings through.

<a id="auto-03"></a>

**AUTO-03** Per-contract or per-unit fee (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A defensible structure for pricing a service whose human effort has been sharply reduced by automation.

- Related: [PM-011](#pm-011) Per-transaction or per-unit, [PM-012](#pm-012) Per-document, per-contract or per-matter
- Claims: [CLM-B-0032](#clm-b-0032), [CLM-B-0031](#clm-b-0031)
- Attributes: provider_perspective: Scales with demand; AI efficiency improves contribution.; client_perspective: Clear linkage to consumption.; principal_risk: Complexity variation and falling market prices.; benefit_allocation_note: Benefit is provider-retained at a given unit price.

<a id="auto-04"></a>

**AUTO-04** Base platform or capacity plus unit fee (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A defensible structure for pricing a service whose human effort has been sharply reduced by automation.

- Related: [PM-023](#pm-023) Hybrid fixed plus variable, [PM-029](#pm-029) Implementation plus recurring support or platform
- Claims: [CLM-B-0032](#clm-b-0032), [CLM-B-0031](#clm-b-0031)
- Attributes: provider_perspective: Recovers fixed engineering and readiness costs plus variable processing.; client_perspective: Separates fixed capability from use.; principal_risk: Requires defensible base and unit definitions.; benefit_allocation_note: Allocation depends on how base and unit rates are set.

<a id="auto-05"></a>

**AUTO-05** Shared-savings or outcome fee (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A defensible structure for pricing a service whose human effort has been sharply reduced by automation.

## Normalized foundational billing bases

Scheme `billing_bases`.

<a id="bb-time"></a>

**BB-TIME** Time (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: professional effort. Fundamental calculation: Fee = Time * Rate.

- Billing bases: `TIME`
- Methods: `TIME`
- Related: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials, [PM-002](#pm-002) Blended hourly rate, [PM-003](#pm-003) Role or seniority rate card, [PM-020](#pm-020) Capped time and materials
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: TIME; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Professional effort; calculation: Fee = Time * Rate

<a id="bb-resource"></a>

**BB-RESOURCE** Resource (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: named or qualified people or fte capacity. Fundamental calculation: Fee = Resources * ResourceRate * Period.

- Billing bases: `RESOURCE`
- Methods: `DEDICATED_RESOURCE`
- Related: [PM-004](#pm-004) Dedicated FTE or resource unit, [PM-005](#pm-005) Staff augmentation or secondment
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: RESOURCE; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Named or qualified people or FTE capacity; calculation: Fee = Resources * ResourceRate * Period

<a id="bb-capacity"></a>

**BB-CAPACITY** Capacity (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: availability or throughput reservation. Fundamental calculation: Fee = ReservedCapacity * CapacityRate.

- Billing bases: `CAPACITY`
- Related: [PM-009](#pm-009) Capacity reservation, [PM-010](#pm-010) Subscription service
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: CAPACITY; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Availability or throughput reservation; calculation: Fee = ReservedCapacity * CapacityRate

<a id="bb-output"></a>

**BB-OUTPUT** Output or transaction (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: completed units. Fundamental calculation: Fee = Sum(Units_i * UnitRate_i).

- Billing bases: `OUTPUT`
- Methods: `UNIT_OUTPUT`, `WEIGHTED_UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [PM-011](#pm-011) Per-transaction or per-unit, [PM-012](#pm-012) Per-document, per-contract or per-matter, [PM-015](#pm-015) Complexity-weighted unit pricing
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: OUTPUT; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Completed units; calculation: Fee = Sum(Units_i * UnitRate_i)

<a id="bb-usage"></a>

**BB-USAGE** Usage (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: metered technology or service consumption. Fundamental calculation: Fee = Sum(Usage_i * MeterRate_i).

- Billing bases: `USAGE`
- Related: [PM-013](#pm-013) Unit consumption, [PM-030](#pm-030) AI or automation consumption, [PM-034](#pm-034) Committed consumption or take-or-pay usage
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: USAGE; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Metered technology or service consumption; calculation: Fee = Sum(Usage_i * MeterRate_i)

<a id="bb-fixed"></a>

**BB-FIXED** Fixed entitlement (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: defined scope or obligation regardless of effort. Fundamental calculation: Contractually fixed fee.

- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`, `FIXED_PROJECT`
- Related: [PM-006](#pm-006) Fixed-fee project, [PM-022](#pm-022) Portfolio or bundled fixed fee
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: FIXED; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Defined scope or obligation regardless of effort; calculation: Contractually fixed fee

<a id="bb-recurring"></a>

**BB-RECURRING** Recurring entitlement (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: ongoing service or access over time. Fundamental calculation: Periodic fixed charge.

- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`
- Related: [PM-007](#pm-007) Fixed-fee managed service, [PM-008](#pm-008) Monthly or annual retainer, [PM-010](#pm-010) Subscription service
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: FIXED; cadence_note: periodic cadence; economic_object: Ongoing service or access over time; calculation: Periodic fixed charge
- Caveat: Executable representation is FIXED with a periodic charge cadence (MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or ANNUAL).

<a id="bb-milestone"></a>

**BB-MILESTONE** Milestone or deliverable (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: completion or acceptance event. Fundamental calculation: Fee = Sum(MilestonePayment_j).

- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_PROJECT`
- Related: [PM-016](#pm-016) Milestone fee, [PM-017](#pm-017) Phase-based fee, [PM-018](#pm-018) Deliverable-based fee
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: FIXED; cadence_note: event cadence; economic_object: Completion or acceptance event; calculation: Fee = Sum(MilestonePayment_j)
- Caveat: Executable representation is FIXED (or OUTPUT for a deliverable with a counting rule) with EVENT cadence and a declared trigger.

<a id="bb-cost"></a>

**BB-COST** Cost (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: provider-incurred eligible cost. Fundamental calculation: Fee = EligibleCost + Markup.

- Billing bases: `COST`
- Methods: `COST_PLUS`
- Related: [PM-019](#pm-019) Cost-plus
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: COST; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Provider-incurred eligible cost; calculation: Fee = EligibleCost + Markup

<a id="bb-outcome"></a>

**BB-OUTCOME** Outcome or value (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billing basis whose economic object purchased is: defined result, savings or recovery. Fundamental calculation: Formula linked to outcome.

- Billing bases: `OUTCOME`
- Methods: `OUTCOME_ADJUSTMENT`
- Related: [PM-024](#pm-024) Value or outcome pricing, [PM-026](#pm-026) Gain-share or verified savings, [PM-027](#pm-027) Success or contingent fee
- Claims: [CLM-B-0002](#clm-b-0002)
- Attributes: core_basis: OUTCOME; cadence_note: any cadence; economic_object: Defined result, savings or recovery; calculation: Formula linked to outcome

## Client priorities for structure proposals

Scheme `client_priorities`.

<a id="budget_certainty"></a>

**budget_certainty** Budget certainty (`D_PROPOSED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

The client wants to know what it will spend. Served by structures whose spend is fixed or bounded.

- Synonyms: predictable spend, cost certainty
- Related: [SEL-007](#sel-007) Strong client budget-certainty preference
- Attributes: fits: {"in": ["FIXED", "BOUNDED"], "path": "labels.spend_variability"}; tension: {"equals": "VARIABLE", "path": "labels.spend_variability"}; tension_note: Spend moves with volume.; suggests: CL-V07

<a id="pay_for_use"></a>

**pay_for_use** Pay for use (`D_PROPOSED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

The client wants to pay for the work it sends and not for unused capacity. Served by structures where the client does not absorb a volume shortfall.

- Synonyms: flexibility, pay as you go
- Related: [SEL-008](#sel-008) Strong client flexibility preference
- Attributes: fits: {"all": [{"not": {"equals": "CLIENT", "path": "labels.volume_shortfall"}}, {"not": {"equals": "FIXED", "path": "labels.spend_variability"}}]}; tension: {"equals": "CLIENT", "path": "labels.volume_shortfall"}; tension_note: The client pays for capacity it does not use.; suggests: CL-R06

<a id="cost_reduction_over_time"></a>

**cost_reduction_over_time** Cost reduction over time (`D_PROPOSED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

The client wants its unit cost to fall as volume grows. Served by volume bands, discounts, or rebates.

- Synonyms: savings with scale
- Attributes: fits: {"any": [{"equals": "PM-014", "path": "base_model"}, {"in": ["CL-V04", "CL-V05"], "path": "levers[*]"}]}; tension: {"not": {"any": [{"equals": "PM-014", "path": "base_model"}, {"in": ["CL-V04", "CL-V05"], "path": "levers[*]"}]}}; tension_note: Nothing lowers the price as volume grows.; suggests: CL-V04, CL-V05

<a id="outcome_alignment"></a>

**outcome_alignment** Outcome alignment (`D_PROPOSED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

The client wants the provider's fees to respond to service performance. Served by service credits or performance bonuses.

- Synonyms: performance alignment
- Attributes: fits: {"in": ["CL-P01", "CL-P02"], "path": "levers[*]"}; tension: {"not": {"in": ["CL-P01", "CL-P02"], "path": "levers[*]"}}; tension_note: Fees do not respond to service performance.; suggests: CL-P01, CL-P02
- Caveat: Outcome-based fees (gain-share
- Caveat: success fees) are not proposed in this version.

<a id="simplicity"></a>

**simplicity** Simplicity (`D_PROPOSED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

The client wants a structure that is easy to understand and administer. Served by structures with at most one lever.

- Synonyms: easy to administer
- Attributes: fits: {"lte": 1, "path": "lever_count"}; tension: {"gte": 3, "path": "lever_count"}; tension_note: Several mechanisms to administer.

<a id="scheme-levers"></a>

## Commercial lever catalog

Scheme `levers`.

<a id="cl-r01"></a>

**CL-R01** Minimum spend commitment (`B_CORROBORATED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Client guarantees periodic spend.

- Kind: `modifier`
- Related: [PM-034](#pm-034) Committed consumption or take-or-pay usage, [CL-R02](#cl-r02) Take-or-pay, [MECH-001](#mech-001) Committed spend plus discounted usage plus on-demand overage
- Claims: [CLM-B-0008](#clm-b-0008), [CLM-B-0010](#clm-b-0010), [CLM-B-0046](#clm-b-0046)
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: Client guarantees periodic spend.; economic_effect: Revenue floor; client underutilization or value risk. Works with unit, usage or catalog pricing.; normalization: Minimum commitment modifies revenue and volume exposure.

<a id="cl-r02"></a>

**CL-R02** Take-or-pay (`B_CORROBORATED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Payment is due for the committed entitlement whether used or not.

- Related: [CL-R01](#cl-r01) Minimum spend commitment, [PM-034](#pm-034) Committed consumption or take-or-pay usage
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: Payment is due for the committed entitlement whether used or not.; economic_effect: Strong provider protection; highest client under-consumption exposure.
- Caveat: Evidence is from adjacent sectors.

<a id="cl-r03"></a>

**CL-R03** Reserved capacity (`B_CORROBORATED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Provider holds defined capacity for the client.

- Related: [PM-009](#pm-009) Capacity reservation, [MECH-002](#mech-002) Reserved capacity
- Claims: [CLM-B-0010](#clm-b-0010)
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: Provider holds defined capacity for the client.; economic_effect: Converts idle-capacity risk partly to the client; capacity must genuinely be available.

<a id="cl-r04"></a>

**CL-R04** Retainer drawdown (`A_DIRECT`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A periodic fee is consumed against services.

- Related: [PM-008](#pm-008) Monthly or annual retainer
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: A periodic fee is consumed against services.; economic_effect: Gives predictable revenue with usage visibility.

<a id="cl-r05"></a>

**CL-R05** Prepaid credits (`A_DIRECT`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

Client buys service credits in advance.

- Related: [PM-031](#pm-031) Service-credit subscription or prepaid credits, [CL-VL03](#cl-vl03) Transferable credits
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: Client buys service credits in advance.; economic_effect: Cash-flow advantage; requires credit valuation and expiry rules.

<a id="cl-r06"></a>

**CL-R06** Rollover (`C_INFERENCE`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Unused entitlement moves forward to a later period.

- Related: [CL-R07](#cl-r07) Use-it-or-lose-it
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: Unused entitlement moves forward to a later period.; economic_effect: Improves fairness but creates future delivery liability and capacity bunching.
- Caveat: Classified C as a design for the legal-services sector; the report notes rollover is common in adjacent subscriptions.

<a id="cl-r07"></a>

**CL-R07** Use-it-or-lose-it (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Unused entitlement expires at the end of its period.

- Related: [CL-R06](#cl-r06) Rollover
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: Unused entitlement expires at the end of its period.; economic_effect: Protects provider economics; increases client perceived-waste risk.

<a id="cl-r08"></a>

**CL-R08** Multi-year commitment (`B_CORROBORATED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A longer term is given in exchange for price or investment consideration.

- Related: [MECH-010](#mech-010) Multi-year as-a-service subscription, [CL-P14](#cl-p14) Termination right or fee
- Claims: [CLM-B-0005](#clm-b-0005)
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: A longer term is given in exchange for price or investment consideration.; economic_effect: Supports transition and automation recovery; increases termination and forecast risk.

<a id="cl-r09"></a>

**CL-R09** Setup or onboarding fee (`B_CORROBORATED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Recovers transition cost separately from the run-rate fee.

- Related: [PM-029](#pm-029) Implementation plus recurring support or platform
- Attributes: category: REVENUE_COMMITMENT; purpose: Recovers transition cost separately from the run-rate fee.; economic_effect: Prevents the run-rate fee from absorbing one-time economics.

<a id="cl-r10"></a>

- Claims: [CLM-B-0008](#clm-b-0008)

- Claims: [CLM-B-0021](#clm-b-0021)
- Attributes: formula: CP = Revenue - VariableCosts - EngagementAvoidableFixedCosts; unit_period: currency; limitation: Scope of 'avoidable' must be explicit.; computed_by: contribution_profit; family: financial
- Caveat: Cometric's contribution_profit subtracts margin layers (DIRECT_DELIVERY and ENGAGEMENT_AVOIDABLE); it equals FM-018 only when all direct delivery costs are avoidable. The engine reports unavoidable direct cost separately so FM-018 can be reconstructed.

<a id="fm-019"></a>

**FM-019** Contribution margin (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Contribution profit as a share of revenue.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0021](#clm-b-0021)
- Attributes: formula: CM = CP / Revenue; unit_period: %; limitation: Useful for incremental decisions; not a full P&L.; computed_by: contribution_margin; family: financial

<a id="fm-020"></a>

**FM-020** Operating profit (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Revenue minus direct, allocated operating and overhead expenses as defined.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0021](#clm-b-0021)
- Attributes: unit_period: currency; limitation: Allocation policy can dominate the result.; family: financial

<a id="fm-021"></a>

**FM-021** Markup (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Price less cost, as a share of cost.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0023](#clm-b-0023)
- Attributes: formula: (Price - Cost) / Cost; unit_period: %; limitation: A 25% markup is not a 25% margin.; computed_by: markup; family: financial

<a id="fm-022"></a>

**FM-022** Margin (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Price less cost, as a share of price.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0023](#clm-b-0023)
- Attributes: formula: (Price - Cost) / Price; unit_period: %; limitation: A 25% margin implies a 33.33% markup.; computed_by: margin; family: financial

<a id="fm-023"></a>

**FM-023** Effective billing rate (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Revenue attributable to labor divided by productive hours.

- Attributes: formula: LaborRevenue / ProductiveHours; unit_period: currency / hour; limitation: For fixed fees, may be retrospective.; computed_by: effective_billing_rate; family: financial

<a id="fm-024"></a>

**FM-024** Revenue per FTE (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Revenue divided by average delivery FTEs.

- Attributes: formula: Revenue / AverageDeliveryFTE; unit_period: currency / FTE; limitation: Mix and automation make comparisons imperfect.; family: financial

<a id="fm-025"></a>

**FM-025** Revenue per productive hour (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Revenue divided by productive delivery hours.

- Attributes: formula: Revenue / ProductiveDeliveryHours; unit_period: currency / hour; limitation: Can increase when AI reduces human hours.; family: financial

<a id="fm-026"></a>

**FM-026** Utilization (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Productive hours divided by available working hours.

- Attributes: formula: ProductiveHours / AvailableWorkingHours; unit_period: %; limitation: Definition varies; 'productive' may include nonbillable client work.; computed_by: productive_hours_utilization; family: financial

<a id="fm-027"></a>

**FM-027** Billable utilization (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billable hours divided by available hours.

- Attributes: formula: BillableHours / AvailableHours; unit_period: %; limitation: Not useful as the sole metric in output pricing.; family: financial

<a id="fm-028"></a>

**FM-028** Realization (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Billed value divided by standard or worked value, according to policy.

- Attributes: formula: BilledValue / StandardOrWorkedValue; unit_period: %; limitation: Definitions vary between organizations.; computed_by: realization; family: financial

<a id="fm-029"></a>

**FM-029** Collection rate (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Cash collected divided by the billed amount for a comparable cohort.

- Attributes: formula: CashCollected / BilledAmount; unit_period: %; limitation: Cohort timing needed; otherwise distortions occur.; family: financial

<a id="fm-030"></a>

**FM-030** Unit contribution (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Unit price less unit variable cost.

- Attributes: formula: UnitPrice - UnitVariableCost; unit_period: currency / unit; limitation: Only valid if the unit is homogeneous or normalized.; computed_by: unit_contribution; family: financial

<a id="fm-031"></a>

**FM-031** Break-even volume (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Volume at which contribution reaches zero, where algebraically appropriate.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0025](#clm-b-0025)
- Attributes: formula: Q_BE = (FixedCost - FixedRevenue) / (UnitPrice - UnitVariableCost); unit_period: units; limitation: Piecewise fees require a piecewise solution.; computed_by: break_even_volume; family: financial

<a id="fm-032"></a>

**FM-032** Capacity utilization (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Actual capacity consumed divided by usable committed capacity.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0026](#clm-b-0026)
- Attributes: formula: ConsumedCapacity / UsableCommittedCapacity; unit_period: %; limitation: Different from personnel billable utilization.; computed_by: capacity_utilization; family: financial

<a id="fm-033"></a>

**FM-033** Cost to serve (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Attributable delivery and support cost for an account or service.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0022](#clm-b-0022)
- Attributes: unit_period: currency; limitation: Allocation policy required.; computed_by: cost_to_serve; family: financial

<a id="fm-034"></a>

**FM-034** Customer lifetime value (CLV) (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Discounted expected future contribution less acquisition and retention cost.

- Attributes: unit_period: currency; limitation: Highly assumption-sensitive in professional services.; family: financial

<a id="fm-035"></a>

**FM-035** Renewal contribution value (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Expected contribution from renewal multiplied by its probability, less renewal cost.

- Attributes: formula: E[RenewalContribution] * P(renewal) - RenewalCost; unit_period: currency; limitation: Probability generally requires internal data.; family: financial

<a id="chi-001"></a>

**CHI-001** Commitment utilization ratio (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A low value signals possible under-consumption. Computed as Consumed eligible value / committed eligible value.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Consumed eligible value / committed eligible value; limitation: Does not value availability.; computed_by: commitment_utilization; interpretation: A low value signals possible under-consumption.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-002"></a>

**CHI-002** Effective client cost per unit (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

A rising value may indicate poor economics. Computed as Total client fee / completed normalized units.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Total client fee / completed normalized units; limitation: Unit normalization required.; computed_by: effective_client_unit_price; interpretation: A rising value may indicate poor economics.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-003"></a>

**CHI-003** Capacity utilization (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Measures operational consumption. Computed as Used capacity / reserved capacity.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Used capacity / reserved capacity; limitation: 100% may actually indicate insufficient buffer.; computed_by: capacity_utilization; interpretation: Measures operational consumption.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-004"></a>

**CHI-004** Forecast variance (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Persistent directional error may indicate structural mismatch. Computed as (Actual - Forecast) / Forecast.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: (Actual - Forecast) / Forecast; limitation: Forecast quality matters.; requires: actuals; interpretation: Persistent directional error may indicate structural mismatch.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-005"></a>

**CHI-005** Service-credit frequency (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Signals repeated performance misses. Computed as Credit events / measurement periods.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Credit events / measurement periods; limitation: Credits vary in severity.; requires: actuals; interpretation: Signals repeated performance misses.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-006"></a>

**CHI-006** Quality-adjusted throughput (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Balances speed and quality. Computed as Completed units * quality adjustment / period.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Completed units * quality adjustment / period; limitation: The quality adjustment can be subjective.; requires: actuals; interpretation: Balances speed and quality.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-007"></a>

**CHI-007** Margin sensitivity to consumption (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Identifies volume exposure. Computed as Delta(Margin) / Delta(Volume).

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Delta(Margin) / Delta(Volume); limitation: Nonlinear contracts require scenario analysis.; computed_by: margin_sensitivity_to_volume; interpretation: Identifies volume exposure.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-008"></a>

**CHI-008** Renewal price pressure (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Potential misalignment signal. Computed as Requested concession / current fee.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Requested concession / current fee; limitation: Negotiation behavior is noisy.; requires: actuals; interpretation: Potential misalignment signal.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-009"></a>

**CHI-009** Client value-realization ratio (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Broad economic comparison. Computed as Quantified realized value / fee.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Quantified realized value / fee; limitation: Many benefits cannot be reliably monetized.; requires: actuals; interpretation: Broad economic comparison.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-010"></a>

**CHI-010** Unused commitment trend (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Persistent under-use may precede repricing. Computed as Unused entitlement over rolling periods.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039), [CLM-B-0040](#clm-b-0040)
- Attributes: formula: Unused entitlement over rolling periods; limitation: Not empirically validated as a retention predictor.; requires: actuals; interpretation: Persistent under-use may precede repricing.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.
- Caveat: Not empirically validated as a retention predictor.

<a id="chi-011"></a>

**CHI-011** Capacity-service mismatch (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Highlights structural overcapacity. Computed as Reserved capacity - actual or forecast demand.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Reserved capacity - actual or forecast demand; limitation: Depends on the capacity model.; computed_by: capacity_service_mismatch; interpretation: Highlights structural overcapacity.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="chi-012"></a>

**CHI-012** Effective cost trend (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Detects rising unit economics despite fixed spend. Computed as Current cost per unit versus prior normalized periods.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0039](#clm-b-0039)
- Attributes: formula: Current cost per unit versus prior normalized periods; limitation: Mix adjustment necessary.; requires: actuals; interpretation: Detects rising unit economics despite fixed spend.; family: commercial_health
- Caveat: Management indicator, not a validated industry threshold.

<a id="mar-001"></a>

**MAR-001** Margin-at-Risk (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Proposed measure of downside in contribution: target contribution less a chosen lower quantile of the simulated contribution distribution.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0028](#clm-b-0028), [CLM-B-0027](#clm-b-0027)
- Attributes: formula: MaR_alpha = TargetContribution - Quantile_alpha(Contribution); unit_period: currency / scenario horizon; limitation: Meaningful only with empirically calibrated distributions.; requires: distributions; family: risk
- Caveat: The report classifies this C/D for management use unless an organization defines it formally.
- Caveat: Not computed in v1; requires calibrated probability distributions.

<a id="mar-002"></a>

**MAR-002** Client Value-at-Risk (`D_PROPOSED`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Candidate advisory measure of downside in realized client value relative to committed spend.

- Claims: [CLM-B-0029](#clm-b-0029)
- Attributes: limitation: No validated definition exists.; requires: distributions; family: risk
- Caveat: Insufficient public evidence to treat as a validated metric; candidate advisory construct only.
- Caveat: Not computed in v1; requires calibrated probability distributions.

<a id="scheme-negotiation-exchanges"></a>

## Commercial negotiation as exchange of risk

Scheme `negotiation_exchanges`.

<a id="neg-001"></a>

**NEG-001** Lower unit price for minimum volume or spend (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'lower unit price' in exchange for 'minimum volume or spend'. Provider trades price for utilization certainty.

- Related: [CL-V04](#cl-v04) Volume discount, [CL-R01](#cl-r01) Minimum spend commitment
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Lower unit price; client_concession: Minimum volume or spend; rationale: Provider trades price for utilization certainty.

<a id="neg-002"></a>

**NEG-002** Lower base fee for higher overage (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'lower base fee' in exchange for 'higher overage'. Client gains a lower fixed commitment; provider recovers upside in high demand.

- Related: [CL-R10](#cl-r10) Base fee plus variable charge, [CL-V02](#cl-v02) Overage
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Lower base fee; client_concession: Higher overage; rationale: Client gains a lower fixed commitment; provider recovers upside in high demand.

<a id="neg-003"></a>

**NEG-003** Lower implementation fee for longer term or termination recovery (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'lower implementation fee' in exchange for 'longer term or termination recovery'. Provider amortizes investment.

- Related: [CL-R09](#cl-r09) Setup or onboarding fee, [CL-R08](#cl-r08) Multi-year commitment, [CL-P14](#cl-p14) Termination right or fee
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Lower implementation fee; client_concession: Longer term or termination recovery; rationale: Provider amortizes investment.

<a id="neg-004"></a>

**NEG-004** Stronger SLA for higher price or capacity commitment (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'stronger sla' in exchange for 'higher price or capacity commitment'. A service guarantee requires buffer capacity.

- Related: [CL-P04](#cl-p04) Turnaround SLA, [CL-R03](#cl-r03) Reserved capacity
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Stronger SLA; client_concession: Higher price or capacity commitment; rationale: A service guarantee requires buffer capacity.

<a id="neg-005"></a>

**NEG-005** Productivity guarantee for automation investment recovery (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'productivity guarantee' in exchange for 'automation investment recovery'. Provider funds transformation in exchange for a return mechanism.

- Related: [CL-P05](#cl-p05) Productivity glide path
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Productivity guarantee; client_concession: Automation investment recovery; rationale: Provider funds transformation in exchange for a return mechanism.

<a id="neg-006"></a>

**NEG-006** Greater rollover for narrower service-credit rights or longer term (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'greater rollover' in exchange for 'narrower service-credit rights or longer term'. Provider accepts a deferred obligation.

- Related: [CL-R06](#cl-r06) Rollover, [CL-P01](#cl-p01) SLA service credit
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Greater rollover; client_concession: Narrower service-credit rights or longer term; rationale: Provider accepts a deferred obligation.

<a id="neg-007"></a>

**NEG-007** More flexible catalog for lower volume discount (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'more flexible catalog' in exchange for 'lower volume discount'. Flexibility reduces provider forecast certainty.

- Related: [CL-VL04](#cl-vl04) Flexible service catalog, [CL-V04](#cl-v04) Volume discount
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: More flexible catalog; client_concession: Lower volume discount; rationale: Flexibility reduces provider forecast certainty.

<a id="neg-008"></a>

**NEG-008** Capacity guarantee for committed spend (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'capacity guarantee' in exchange for 'committed spend'. Provider is compensated for reserved resources.

- Related: [CL-R03](#cl-r03) Reserved capacity, [CL-R01](#cl-r01) Minimum spend commitment
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Capacity guarantee; client_concession: Committed spend; rationale: Provider is compensated for reserved resources.

<a id="neg-009"></a>

**NEG-009** Shared savings for baseline and audit rights (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'shared savings' in exchange for 'baseline and audit rights'. Provider needs reliable attribution.

- Related: [CL-P07](#cl-p07) Shared savings
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Shared savings; client_concession: Baseline and audit rights; rationale: Provider needs reliable attribution.

<a id="neg-010"></a>

**NEG-010** Fixed fee for stronger change control (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Negotiation exchange: the provider concedes 'fixed fee' in exchange for 'stronger change control'. Provider accepts cost risk only inside a bounded scope.

- Related: [PM-006](#pm-006) Fixed-fee project, [CL-D11](#cl-d11) Change order
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: provider_concession: Fixed fee; client_concession: Stronger change control; rationale: Provider accepts cost risk only inside a bounded scope.

<a id="scheme-offers"></a>

## Three defensible offers for one engagement

Scheme `offers`.

<a id="offer-a"></a>

**OFFER-A** Low commitment, high variable (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

One of three defensible offers for the same recurring contract-review service. Annual base fee of $400,000 (illustrative) plus higher unit charges.

- Related: [PM-023](#pm-023) Hybrid fixed plus variable, [CL-R10](#cl-r10) Base fee plus variable charge
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: structure: Annual base fee of $400,000 (illustrative) plus higher unit charges.; tradeoff: Maximizes client flexibility but gives the provider less revenue certainty.; illustrative: True
- Caveat: Dollar amounts are illustrative figures from the report, not benchmarks.
- Caveat: None of the three offers is universally superior; selection depends on demand distribution, availability needs, client budget preferences and provider redeployment capability.

<a id="offer-b"></a>

**OFFER-B** High commitment, lower marginal (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

One of three defensible offers for the same recurring contract-review service. Annual minimum of $800,000 (illustrative) including a substantial allowance, plus reduced overage.

- Related: [CL-R01](#cl-r01) Minimum spend commitment, [CL-V01](#cl-v01) Included allowance, [CL-V02](#cl-v02) Overage
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: structure: Annual minimum of $800,000 (illustrative) including a substantial allowance, plus reduced overage.; tradeoff: Transfers under-consumption risk toward the client but supports lower marginal pricing.; illustrative: True
- Caveat: Dollar amounts are illustrative figures from the report, not benchmarks.
- Caveat: None of the three offers is universally superior; selection depends on demand distribution, availability needs, client budget preferences and provider redeployment capability.

<a id="offer-c"></a>

**OFFER-C** Dedicated capacity (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

One of three defensible offers for the same recurring contract-review service. Fixed annual FTE or capacity charge plus separately priced overflow.

- Related: [PM-004](#pm-004) Dedicated FTE or resource unit, [PM-009](#pm-009) Capacity reservation, [CL-R03](#cl-r03) Reserved capacity
- Claims: [CLM-B-0004](#clm-b-0004)
- Attributes: structure: Fixed annual FTE or capacity charge plus separately priced overflow.; tradeoff: Maximizes continuity and availability but exposes the client to value concerns if capacity is unused.; illustrative: True
- Caveat: None of the three offers is universally superior; selection depends on demand distribution, availability needs, client budget preferences and provider redeployment capability.

<a id="scheme-pricing-models"></a>

## Pricing model catalog

Scheme `pricing_models`.

<a id="pm-001"></a>

**PM-001** Hourly time and materials (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Fees equal recorded, approved hours multiplied by hourly rates; the client buys professional effort.

- Synonyms: time and materials, T&M, hourly
- Billing bases: `TIME`
- Methods: `TIME`
- Related: [PM-002](#pm-002) Blended hourly rate, [PM-003](#pm-003) Role or seniority rate card, [PM-020](#pm-020) Capped time and materials
- Attributes: formula: F = Sum_r(h_r * r_r); applications: Advisory, project work, uncertain scope. Invoice triggered by recorded approved time.; provider_client_economics: Low provider scope risk; client carries duration and productivity risk. Revenue variable; cost visibility moderate.; source_basis: BB-TIME

<a id="pm-002"></a>

**PM-002** Blended hourly rate (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A single averaged hourly rate applied to all hours worked by a multi-level team.

- Synonyms: blended rate
- Billing bases: `TIME`
- Methods: `TIME`
- Broader: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials
- Related: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials, [CL-D04](#cl-d04) Seniority and skill mix
- Attributes: formula: F = H * r_b; applications: Multi-level teams where one averaged rate reduces rate-card complexity.; provider_client_economics: Simplifies budgeting; creates a provider incentive to optimize seniority mix and a risk of adverse mix if senior input exceeds assumptions.; source_basis: BB-TIME

<a id="pm-003"></a>

**PM-003** Role or seniority rate card (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Time-based pricing in which hourly rates are indexed to role, seniority or skill.

- Synonyms: rate card, role-based rates
- Billing bases: `TIME`
- Methods: `TIME`
- Broader: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials
- Related: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials, [CL-D04](#cl-d04) Seniority and skill mix
- Attributes: applications: Consulting, technology implementation, legal operations.; provider_client_economics: Transparent labor pricing but exposes the client to hours and mix.; source_basis: BB-TIME

<a id="pm-004"></a>

**PM-004** Dedicated FTE or resource unit (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

The client pays per dedicated full-time-equivalent resource per period, purchasing dedicated resource capacity.

- Synonyms: FTE pricing, dedicated resource
- Billing bases: `RESOURCE`
- Methods: `DEDICATED_RESOURCE`
- Related: [PM-009](#pm-009) Capacity reservation, [CL-D01](#cl-d01) Dedicated team, [CL-R03](#cl-r03) Reserved capacity
- Claims: [CLM-B-0048](#clm-b-0048)
- Attributes: formula: F = N_FTE * R_FTE; applications: Ongoing legal operations, contract teams, processing teams.; provider_client_economics: Predictable revenue and cost; low utilization becomes a client-value issue; high demand can create overtime or capacity pressure.; source_basis: BB-RESOURCE

<a id="pm-005"></a>

**PM-005** Staff augmentation or secondment (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

The provider supplies resources who work under client direction, priced per resource period or by time.

- Synonyms: secondment, staff augmentation
- Billing bases: `RESOURCE`, `TIME`
- Methods: `DEDICATED_RESOURCE`, `TIME`
- Related: [PM-004](#pm-004) Dedicated FTE or resource unit, [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials
- Attributes: applications: Temporary gaps, specialist work, workload spikes.; provider_client_economics: Client controls the work; provider assumes less output risk.; source_basis: BB-RESOURCE, BB-TIME

<a id="pm-006"></a>

**PM-006** Fixed-fee project (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A single fixed fee for a defined scope, regardless of the effort required.

- Synonyms: fixed fee, fixed price project
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_PROJECT`
- Related: [CL-D10](#cl-d10) Scope assumptions and exclusions, [CL-D11](#cl-d11) Change order, [PM-017](#pm-017) Phase-based fee
- Claims: [CLM-B-0049](#clm-b-0049)
- Attributes: formula: F = F_0 for defined scope; applications: CLM implementation, remediation, migration, reviews.; provider_client_economics: Provider assumes effort and cost-overrun risk; client gains budget certainty. Requires scope and change control.; source_basis: BB-FIXED

<a id="pm-007"></a>

**PM-007** Fixed-fee managed service (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A recurring fixed fee for an ongoing defined service for which the provider is accountable for output and service levels.

- Synonyms: fixed managed service
- Kind: `modifier`
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`
- Related: [CL-P01](#cl-p01) SLA service credit, [CL-V07](#cl-v07) Consumption cap, [CL-V08](#cl-v08) Volume corridor or collar, [PM-028](#pm-028) Technology-enabled managed service
- Claims: [CLM-B-0005](#clm-b-0005), [CLM-B-0043](#clm-b-0043)
- Attributes: applications: Ongoing defined service with the provider accountable for output and SLA.; provider_client_economics: Revenue highly predictable; volume and cost risk may sit with the provider unless bounded.; source_basis: BB-FIXED, BB-RECURRING; normalization: Managed service describes accountability and delivery architecture, not necessarily the billing basis.

<a id="pm-008"></a>

**PM-008** Monthly or annual retainer (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A periodic fixed fee for access to expertise or defined ongoing support.

- Synonyms: retainer
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`
- Related: [CL-R04](#cl-r04) Retainer drawdown
- Attributes: applications: Access to expertise or defined ongoing support.; provider_client_economics: Predictable spend and revenue; underutilization can raise value concerns.; source_basis: BB-RECURRING

<a id="pm-009"></a>

**PM-009** Capacity reservation (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

The client pays for reserved availability or throughput, whether or not it is used.

- Synonyms: reserved capacity
- Billing bases: `CAPACITY`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`
- Related: [CL-R03](#cl-r03) Reserved capacity, [PM-004](#pm-004) Dedicated FTE or resource unit, [MECH-002](#mech-002) Reserved capacity
- Claims: [CLM-B-0010](#clm-b-0010)
- Attributes: formula: Fee = ReservedCapacity * CapacityRate; applications: Reserved lawyers, reviewers, processing slots, service desk throughput.; provider_client_economics: Client pays for availability; provider must preserve capacity whether used or not.; source_basis: BB-CAPACITY

<a id="pm-010"></a>

**PM-010** Subscription service (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A recurring charge for ongoing access to a platform and service bundle, sometimes with a capacity entitlement.

- Synonyms: subscription
- Kind: `modifier`
- Billing bases: `FIXED`, `CAPACITY`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`
- Related: [PM-031](#pm-031) Service-credit subscription or prepaid credits, [MECH-010](#mech-010) Multi-year as-a-service subscription
- Claims: [CLM-B-0005](#clm-b-0005), [CLM-B-0043](#clm-b-0043)
- Attributes: applications: Ongoing platform plus service bundle.; provider_client_economics: Predictable spend, access and governance; entitlement definition is critical.; source_basis: BB-RECURRING, BB-CAPACITY; normalization: Subscription describes cadence and entitlement more than the underlying metering basis.

<a id="pm-011"></a>

**PM-011** Per-transaction or per-unit (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

The fee equals the number of completed units multiplied by a unit price.

- Synonyms: unit pricing, per-unit
- Billing bases: `OUTPUT`
- Methods: `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [PM-012](#pm-012) Per-document, per-contract or per-matter, [PM-015](#pm-015) Complexity-weighted unit pricing
- Claims: [CLM-B-0047](#clm-b-0047)
- Attributes: formula: F = Q * p; applications: Contract reviews, subpoenas, document review, RFPs, matters.; provider_client_economics: Aligns price to activity; provider assumes productivity risk. Requires a unit definition.; source_basis: BB-OUTPUT

<a id="pm-012"></a>

**PM-012** Per-document, per-contract or per-matter (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Output pricing using a specialized unit such as a document, a contract or a matter.

- Synonyms: per-document, per-contract, per-matter
- Billing bases: `OUTPUT`
- Methods: `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Broader: [PM-011](#pm-011) Per-transaction or per-unit
- Related: [PM-015](#pm-015) Complexity-weighted unit pricing
- Attributes: applications: Document review, contract abstraction, contracting managed services.; provider_client_economics: Highly measurable but vulnerable to complexity heterogeneity.; source_basis: BB-OUTPUT

<a id="pm-013"></a>

**PM-013** Unit consumption (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Charges scale with metered consumption of a technology or service.

- Synonyms: consumption pricing, metered pricing
- Billing bases: `USAGE`, `OUTPUT`
- Methods: `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [PM-030](#pm-030) AI or automation consumption, [MECH-009](#mech-009) Consumption pricing
- Attributes: formula: Fee = Sum_i(Usage_i * MeterRate_i); applications: Processing, hosting, transactions, workflow runs.; provider_client_economics: Spend scales with use; less protection for the client budget if demand spikes.; source_basis: BB-USAGE, BB-OUTPUT

<a id="pm-014"></a>

**PM-014** Tiered volume pricing (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A unit or usage rate that changes as volume crosses defined thresholds.

- Synonyms: tiered pricing, volume tiers
- Kind: `modifier`
- Billing bases: `OUTPUT`, `USAGE`
- Methods: `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [CL-V03](#cl-v03) Tiered rate, [CL-V04](#cl-v04) Volume discount, [PM-011](#pm-011) Per-transaction or per-unit
- Claims: [CLM-B-0043](#clm-b-0043)
- Attributes: applications: High-volume repeatable services.; provider_client_economics: Lower marginal rate at scale; incentivizes consolidation and commitment; can create threshold gaming.; source_basis: BB-OUTPUT, BB-USAGE; normalization: Tiered pricing modifies a unit or usage rate.
- Caveat: The report's supporting citation for this statement is not in its evidence register; add a registered source before relying on it.

<a id="pm-015"></a>

**PM-015** Complexity-weighted unit pricing (`C_INFERENCE`, `UNVERIFIED`)

Raw units are converted to weighted units by complexity band before a unit price is applied.

- Synonyms: weighted units, complexity bands
- Kind: `modifier`
- Billing bases: `OUTPUT`
- Methods: `WEIGHTED_UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [PM-011](#pm-011) Per-transaction or per-unit, [PM-012](#pm-012) Per-document, per-contract or per-matter
- Claims: [CLM-B-0043](#clm-b-0043), [CLM-B-0051](#clm-b-0051)
- Attributes: applications: Contracts, matters or tickets varying materially in effort or risk.; provider_client_economics: Better cost-to-price alignment but requires defensible classification and audit controls.; source_basis: BB-OUTPUT; normalization: Complexity weighting modifies the unit definition or rate.
- Caveat: Commercially sensible and consistent with unit-cost approaches; not proven universal.
- Caveat: The report's supporting citation for this statement is not in its evidence register; add a registered source before relying on it.

<a id="pm-016"></a>

**PM-016** Milestone fee (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Payments fall due on completion or acceptance of defined milestones.

- Synonyms: milestone payment
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_PROJECT`
- Related: [PM-017](#pm-017) Phase-based fee, [PM-018](#pm-018) Deliverable-based fee, [PM-029](#pm-029) Implementation plus recurring support or platform
- Attributes: formula: Fee = Sum_j(MilestonePayment_j); applications: Technology deployments, migrations, transformation.; provider_client_economics: Links payment to progress; acceptance criteria become key.; source_basis: BB-MILESTONE

<a id="pm-017"></a>

**PM-017** Phase-based fee (`B_CORROBORATED`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

Separately priced phases, allowing scope to be contained and the work repriced at phase checkpoints.

- Synonyms: phase-by-phase pricing, phased fee
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_PROJECT`
- Related: [PM-016](#pm-016) Milestone fee, [PM-006](#pm-006) Fixed-fee project
- Attributes: applications: Discovery, design, build, migration, run.; provider_client_economics: Contains scope risk within phases; supports repricing at phase checkpoints.; source_basis: BB-MILESTONE, BB-FIXED

<a id="pm-018"></a>

**PM-018** Deliverable-based fee (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Fees tied to defined deliverables and their acceptance.

- Synonyms: deliverable pricing
- Billing bases: `FIXED`, `OUTPUT`
- Methods: `FIXED_PROJECT`, `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [PM-016](#pm-016) Milestone fee
- Attributes: applications: Playbooks, datasets, migrated repository, reports.; provider_client_economics: Strong output alignment; acceptance ambiguity can create disputes.; source_basis: BB-MILESTONE, BB-OUTPUT

<a id="pm-019"></a>

**PM-019** Cost-plus (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

The fee equals eligible provider cost plus a markup or a fixed fee.

- Synonyms: cost plus markup, cost plus fee
- Billing bases: `COST`
- Methods: `COST_PLUS`
- Related: [CL-P09](#cl-p09) Cost-overrun sharing, [CL-D09](#cl-d09) Third-party pass-through
- Claims: [CLM-B-0003](#clm-b-0003)
- Attributes: formula: F = C * (1 + m) or F = C + Fee; applications: Highly uncertain transformation or pass-through work.; provider_client_economics: Client bears cost risk; provider receives protected economics; weak efficiency incentive unless supplemented.; source_basis: BB-COST

<a id="pm-020"></a>

**PM-020** Capped time and materials (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Time-based fees subject to a contractual maximum.

- Synonyms: capped T&M, capped hourly
- Billing bases: `TIME`
- Methods: `TIME`
- Broader: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials
- Related: [PM-001](#pm-001) Hourly time and materials, [PM-021](#pm-021) Not-to-exceed
- Attributes: applications: Uncertain work where the client requires a maximum exposure.; provider_client_economics: Provider bears incremental downside above the cap unless scope changes; client enjoys an upper bound.; source_basis: BB-TIME

<a id="pm-021"></a>

**PM-021** Not-to-exceed (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A contractual maximum applied to an underlying time, output or cost fee.

- Synonyms: NTE, fee ceiling
- Kind: `modifier`
- Billing bases: `TIME`, `OUTPUT`, `COST`
- Related: [PM-020](#pm-020) Capped time and materials
- Claims: [CLM-B-0043](#clm-b-0043)
- Attributes: applications: Projects and matters.; provider_client_economics: Economically similar to capped time and materials; not a separate foundational basis.; normalization: Not-to-exceed modifies an underlying time, cost or unit fee; it is a modifier, not an independent basis.

<a id="pm-022"></a>

**PM-022** Portfolio or bundled fixed fee (`A_DIRECT`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

A fixed fee covering a portfolio of matters, contracts or transactions rather than each one individually.

- Synonyms: portfolio pricing, bundled fixed fee
- Kind: `modifier`
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`, `FIXED_PROJECT`
- Related: [PM-006](#pm-006) Fixed-fee project
- Claims: [CLM-B-0043](#clm-b-0043)
- Attributes: applications: Repetitive matters, litigation portfolios, contract portfolios.; provider_client_economics: Diversifies matter-level variance if the portfolio is sufficiently broad; concentration risk remains.; source_basis: BB-FIXED; normalization: Portfolio pricing changes scope aggregation and risk pooling.
- Caveat: The report's supporting citation for this statement is not in its evidence register; add a registered source before relying on it.

<a id="pm-023"></a>

**PM-023** Hybrid fixed plus variable (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A recurring fixed charge for readiness or an included allowance, plus a metered charge for consumption beyond it.

- Synonyms: base plus overage, base plus variable
- Billing bases: `FIXED`, `OUTPUT`, `USAGE`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`, `ALLOWANCE_OVERAGE`
- Related: [CL-R10](#cl-r10) Base fee plus variable charge, [CL-V01](#cl-v01) Included allowance, [CL-V02](#cl-v02) Overage, [MECH-008](#mech-008) Base plus overage
- Claims: [CLM-B-0008](#clm-b-0008)
- Attributes: applications: Managed services with base capacity or governance and overage.; provider_client_economics: Separates fixed readiness cost from variable consumption; often strong alignment for uncertain demand.; source_basis: BB-RECURRING, BB-FIXED, BB-OUTPUT, BB-USAGE

<a id="pm-024"></a>

**PM-024** Value or outcome pricing (`B_CORROBORATED`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

The fee is linked by formula to a defined result, saving or recovery.

- Synonyms: outcome-based pricing, value pricing
- Billing bases: `OUTCOME`
- Methods: `OUTCOME_ADJUSTMENT`
- Related: [PM-026](#pm-026) Gain-share or verified savings, [MECH-005](#mech-005) Outcome-based managed service
- Claims: [CLM-B-0006](#clm-b-0006), [CLM-B-0041](#clm-b-0041)
- Attributes: formula: Formula linked to outcome; applications: Work where an objective business result can be measured.; provider_client_economics: Can align incentives but requires a measurable outcome, causation and a baseline; creates revenue volatility.; source_basis: BB-OUTCOME

<a id="pm-025"></a>

**PM-025** Performance incentive or bonus (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

An incentive added to a base model that adjusts consideration around measured performance.

- Synonyms: performance fee, incentive fee
- Related: [CL-P02](#cl-p02) Performance bonus, [PM-033](#pm-033) Performance holdback
- Claims: [CLM-B-0006](#clm-b-0006)
- Attributes: applications: SLA improvement, turnaround, quality, savings milestones.; provider_client_economics: Adds upside or downside around a base fee. Performance metric and controllability are essential.

<a id="pm-026"></a>

**PM-026** Gain-share or verified savings (`B_CORROBORATED`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

The provider earns a share of verified savings measured against an auditable baseline.

- Synonyms: gain-share, savings share
- Billing bases: `OUTCOME`
- Methods: `OUTCOME_ADJUSTMENT`
- Related: [CL-P07](#cl-p07) Shared savings, [MECH-007](#mech-007) Shared savings
- Claims: [CLM-B-0006](#clm-b-0006)
- Attributes: applications: Spend reduction, process savings, cost avoidance where the baseline is auditable.; provider_client_economics: Strong incentive alignment but baseline and attribution disputes can be severe.; source_basis: BB-OUTCOME

<a id="pm-027"></a>

**PM-027** Success or contingent fee (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

All or part of the fee depends on achieving a defined result, such as a recovery.

- Synonyms: contingent fee, success fee
- Billing bases: `OUTCOME`
- Methods: `OUTCOME_ADJUSTMENT`
- Related: [PM-024](#pm-024) Value or outcome pricing, [PM-032](#pm-032) Reverse contingency
- Attributes: applications: Recoveries, litigation or a measurable result, where lawful.; provider_client_economics: Provider bears outcome risk for potential upside; legal restrictions depend on jurisdiction and provider.; source_basis: BB-OUTCOME
- Caveat: Legal restrictions depend on jurisdiction, provider type and matter type; legal review is required before use.

<a id="pm-028"></a>

**PM-028** Technology-enabled managed service (`A_DIRECT`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A service that bundles labor, platform, process and risk transfer, usually as a recurring charge with output or usage elements.

- Synonyms: tech-enabled managed service
- Kind: `modifier`
- Billing bases: `FIXED`, `OUTPUT`, `USAGE`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`, `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [PM-007](#pm-007) Fixed-fee managed service
- Claims: [CLM-B-0043](#clm-b-0043)
- Attributes: applications: Contracting, eDiscovery, operations, compliance.; provider_client_economics: Bundles labor, platform, process and risk transfer; economically a configuration rather than a unique billing basis.; source_basis: BB-RECURRING, BB-OUTPUT, BB-USAGE; normalization: Managed service describes accountability and delivery architecture, not necessarily the billing basis; technology-enabled service describes delivery composition.

<a id="pm-029"></a>

**PM-029** Implementation plus recurring support or platform (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A milestone or fixed implementation fee plus recurring support or platform charges.

- Synonyms: build plus run
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_PROJECT`, `FIXED_RECURRING`
- Related: [PM-016](#pm-016) Milestone fee, [CL-R09](#cl-r09) Setup or onboarding fee
- Attributes: applications: CLM, ELM and workflow deployments and ongoing operation.; provider_client_economics: Supports recovery of setup investment separately from run economics.; source_basis: BB-MILESTONE, BB-FIXED, BB-RECURRING

<a id="pm-030"></a>

**PM-030** AI or automation consumption (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

Charges per metered AI or automation unit, such as prompts, documents, pages, tokens or agent actions.

- Synonyms: AI consumption pricing, per-prompt pricing
- Billing bases: `USAGE`
- Methods: `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [PM-013](#pm-013) Unit consumption, [MECH-009](#mech-009) Consumption pricing
- Claims: [CLM-B-0052](#clm-b-0052)
- Attributes: applications: Prompts, documents, pages, tokens, agent actions, processing.; provider_client_economics: Aligns variable technology costs but can reduce budget predictability.; source_basis: BB-USAGE
- Caveat: The report classifies prevalence as emerging for legal services; base prevalence reflects adjacent cloud and SaaS use of consumption pricing.
- Caveat: The report's supporting citation for this statement is not in its evidence register; add a registered source before relying on it.

<a id="pm-031"></a>

**PM-031** Service-credit subscription or prepaid credits (`A_DIRECT`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

A recurring purchase of fungible credits that can be exchanged across a catalog of services.

- Synonyms: prepaid credits, credit subscription
- Billing bases: `FIXED`
- Methods: `FIXED_RECURRING`
- Related: [CL-R05](#cl-r05) Prepaid credits, [CL-VL03](#cl-vl03) Transferable credits, [MECH-003](#mech-003) Usage credits
- Attributes: applications: Multi-service managed review or support catalogs.; provider_client_economics: Preserves commitment while allowing workload substitution; valuation of heterogeneous services is key.; source_basis: BB-RECURRING

<a id="pm-032"></a>

**PM-032** Reverse contingency (`A_DIRECT`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

An outcome fee measured against an avoided-loss baseline, typically in defense work.

- Synonyms: reverse contingent fee
- Billing bases: `OUTCOME`
- Methods: `OUTCOME_ADJUSTMENT`
- Related: [PM-027](#pm-027) Success or contingent fee
- Attributes: applications: Defense and avoided-loss economics.; provider_client_economics: Requires a credible avoided-loss baseline; may create high outcome volatility.; source_basis: BB-OUTCOME
- Caveat: The report's supporting citation for this statement is not in its evidence register; add a registered source before relying on it.

<a id="pm-033"></a>

**PM-033** Performance holdback (`A_DIRECT`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`)

Part of the base fee is held at risk and paid only if defined performance conditions are met.

- Synonyms: holdback, fee at risk
- Related: [PM-025](#pm-025) Performance incentive or bonus, [CL-P02](#cl-p02) Performance bonus
- Attributes: formula: Base fee minus at-risk percentage; applications: Matters or managed services where part of the fee depends on performance.; provider_client_economics: Creates measurable downside without making the total fee wholly contingent.

<a id="pm-034"></a>

**PM-034** Committed consumption or take-or-pay usage (`B_CORROBORATED`, `ESTABLISHED_COMMON`)

A usage-based service with a minimum spend commitment, typically exchanged for a discount, with overage beyond it.

- Synonyms: committed use, take-or-pay usage
- Billing bases: `USAGE`
- Methods: `UNIT_OUTPUT`
- Related: [CL-R01](#cl-r01) Minimum spend commitment, [CL-R02](#cl-r02) Take-or-pay, [MECH-001](#mech-001) Committed spend plus discounted usage plus on-demand overage
- Claims: [CLM-B-0008](#clm-b-0008), [CLM-B-0009](#clm-b-0009)
- Attributes: applications: Technology-heavy managed service with minimum spend and overage.; provider_client_economics: Discount in exchange for a revenue floor; creates under-consumption risk for the client.; source_basis: BB-USAGE
